subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: Should Feishu direct sessions get TTL-aware maintenance protection plus Feishu-owned open_id validation/doctor repair, or should maintainers keep the current account-scoped workaround as the supported path?
rationale: The durable fix affects direct-DM retention policy, existing session-history migration, and Feishu plugin identity validation, so automation should not choose the product and compatibility contract alone.

options.title: TTL-aware retention plus Feishu repair
options.body: Protect recent direct DM sessions from pruning/capping, validate Feishu direct open_ids at the Feishu boundary, and add a doctor migration for malformed or cross-app direct keys.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Keep `per-account-channel-peer` as the supported multi-account workaround and close the remaining malformed-key and retention concerns as unsupported operational cleanup.

options.title: Blanket-protect direct sessions
options.body: Treat all direct sessions as protected maintenance entries, accepting store-growth risk for simpler session-continuity behavior.

recommendation.title: TTL-aware retention plus Feishu repair
recommendation.body: Protect recent direct DM sessions from pruning/capping, validate Feishu direct open_ids at the Feishu boundary, and add a doctor migration for malformed or cross-app direct keys.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice is Feishu-specific while still touching shared session maintenance, and the package metadata points to m1heng as the Feishu plugin ownership signal.
